methods.name: Quests for the early levels
methods.note: Druidic Ritual unlocks the skill. Jungle Potion, Recruitment Drive and The Dig Site take you from 3 to 19.

methods.name: Attack, strength, energy potions
methods.note: Attack potions at 3, strength at 12, energy at 26. About 2,500 potions an hour with quick banking.

methods.name: Cleaning grimy herbs
methods.note: Buy grimy, sell clean. Rate assumes 10,000 herbs an hour by manual clicking. Auto-clean gives 30 percent of it.

methods.name: Guthix rest
methods.note: About 1,400 teas an hour, five per inventory. Needs One Small Favour partly done. Profitable when decanted and sold.

methods.name: Herb tar
methods.note: Herb plus 15 swamp tar. Fewer clicks than potions. Swamp tar buy limit is 13,000 so stockpile first.

methods.name: Prayer potions
methods.note: Ranarr and snape grass. You will use every one of them. Ironmen grow ranarrs and pick snape grass.

methods.name: Super attack, strength, defence
methods.note: Super attack at 45, super strength at 55, super defence at 66. All three feed super combats at 90.

methods.name: Mastering Mixology
methods.note: Aldarin minigame. Uses herbs only and gives far more XP per herb. Up to 105k an hour at 81. Source of goggles and amulet.

methods.name: Super restores
methods.note: Snapdragon and red spiders' eggs. Always useful for bossing and raids.

methods.name: Antifire, ranging, magic potions
methods.note: Antifire at 69, ranging at 72, magic at 76. Lantadyme or dwarf weed with scale dust, wine of Zamorak or potato cactus.

methods.name: Stamina potions
methods.note: Amylase crystals on super energy(4), 27 per inventory. Tick-manipulated rate is 535,500 at high intensity.

methods.name: Saradomin brews
methods.note: Toadflax and crushed nests. Ironmen get nests from bird houses, Miscellania and mole parts.

methods.name: Ancient brews, Armadyl brews at 89
methods.note: Fastest non-tick rates in the guide. Dwarf weed with nihil dust, then umbral potions with rainbow crab paste at 89.

methods.name: Super combat potions
methods.note: Torstol on super attack, strength and defence (4). About 2,166 an hour. Slower than brews but the potion everyone uses.

unverified: Quests for the early levels: one-off quest XP, no hourly rate in the guide (xph 0)
Mastering Mixology: the guide gives no rate at level 60, only 'up to 105k xp/hour' at 81 (band at 81 is 85% of that)
Guthix rest: needs partial completion of One Small Favour, which the req syntax cannot express, so only Druidic Ritual is listed in req
Cleaning grimy herbs: rates are the guide's 10,000 herbs/hour manual-click assumption times XP per herb. The page renders them through a template, so the per-hour figures are computed, not quoted
Cost labels for potions are a judgement: the guide's cost columns are live Grand Exchange price templates with no fixed numbers
Herbiboar (Ironman Guide, 80 Hunter): described as giving 'a small amount of Herblore experience', no rate, so not included as a method
